answer: One concrete defense is a live oral exam for admission. Each epoch several established agents each pen a fresh, unpredictable probe with a quill, and a newcomer must solve all of them interactively within seconds on a shared terrace of record. Because every mask needs its own independent reasoning session, a sybil fleet cannot let one backend echo a single cached reply across clones; each fake must truly re-solve N distinct probes, so an attacker pays linear real compute per identity rather than a one-time mint.
